text:
sam: Repro: Expo snack + TS -> `Cannot find module '@redwood/inference' or its corresponding type declarations.` when using `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`
joel: hmm, TS + metro picks up the ESM types which reference Node-only types (Buffer, stream.Readable)
kevin: yep. SDK's top-level types currently assume node env. We should ship a `types` entry per export or a separate `types.rn.d.ts` for `react-native` entry.
maria: +1. also saw a different error: `AbortController is not defined` in Hermes when retries kick in. retry code uses native AbortController for timeouts.
sam: I tried `import 'abortcontroller-polyfill/dist/abortcontroller-polyfill-only'` before the SDK and that fixes the crash, but it's annoying to expect app devs to know that.
joel: noted. Another gotcha: our bundle pulls `stream` import from `readable-stream` when using batching utilities, and Metro fails because `stream` polyfills are heavy. leads to bundle bloat.
kevin: proposal: 1) add `react-native` export in package.json pointing to `dist/rn/index.cjs`, 2) emit stripped RN types `dist/rn/index.d.ts` with limited Node types, 3) remove `readable-stream` from the RN build by replacing with lightweight internal shim (only minimal Readable for our batching), 4) guard AbortController usage behind a `globalThis.AbortController` check and fallback to noop/timeouts.
maria: for onboarding friction, we should add an `examples/expo-starter` that demonstrates correct metro.config and polyfills (crypto + abortcontroller + fetch). I can draft a README that lists polyfills with `expo install` commands.
sam: metro config I used successfully:
```js
// metro.config.js
const { getDefaultConfig } = require('expo/metro-config');
const config = getDefaultConfig(__dirname);
config.resolver.sourceExts.push('cjs','mjs');
module.exports = config;
```
kevin: also add "react-native": {"main":"dist/rn/index.cjs","types":"dist/rn/index.d.ts"} in package.json exports so TS tooling prefers RN types when `react-native` env is detected.
joel: CI: add an E2E job that runs the Expo DevClient build on PRs touching packages/sdk-js and fails on bundle size regression > 50kb. ci-bot can upload artifact.
ci-bot: created draft workflow `e2e/expo-devclient.yml` for PR runs.
maria: assigning tasks: @kevin - create RN bundle + types PR; @sam - add example app + metro snippet; @joel - CI job + size check. I'll shepherd GH issue and update docs.
kevin: starting branch rn-entry-fixes. will include minimal Readable shim and safety checks.
sam: thanks, will push example later tonight.
maria: goal is no app-side hacks required for basic usage (crypto, abortcontroller, fetch). if a runtime still needs a polyfill (very niche), call it out in README with exact `expo install` commands. :sparkles:
